Badness provides formatting, linting, and editor features for LaTeX and BibTeX.
It supports documents and bibliographies, as well as packages, classes, and
documented source files, including both LaTeX2e and LaTeX3 code.

An incremental parser builds a lossless syntax tree that Badness uses to format
code, report syntax errors, and check best practices. The language server adds
hover information, symbol outlines, go-to-definition, and code actions. Badness
works from the command line and integrates with editors through the Language
Server Protocol, with a VS Code extension that bundles the binary.
